'clustered': a random 200 of the articles the production pipeline sent to issue extraction 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-24. text is exactly what the gate embeds (title + first 200 characters of the description), with politicians' names replaced by '[name]'. Labelled 2026-10-10 against _rubric; ambiguous marks items a second reader could reasonably label the other way.
_rubric: relevant = a U.S. policy, legislation, government or civic story a reader of this site would want: the U.S. government acting (Congress, the President, agencies, state governments on policy, budgets), U.S. courts on law/policy/government, U.S. elections and campaigns, U.S. policy issues framed as policy, U.S. foreign policy and military action where the U.S. government is an actor, civic action aimed at U.S. policy. Not relevant: foreign politics or conflict with no U.S. government actor, disasters and weather without a government-response angle, crime and trials of private people, business and markets without a regulatory angle, sports, entertainment, science and health human-interest, obituaries, lifestyle.
